say.description: Your line to the player: concise mission-control voice, key numbers first, one or two sentences.

reply_intent.description: Only when classifying the player's typed reply to a pending plan; otherwise none.

child_vessels.description: The Child Vessels you plan to fly, each named once; separated vessels not named here are ignored.

name.description: Your name for it, used as the vessel of its sequences.

separation_stage.description: The separation stage that releases it, from the separations facts; -1 for one already separated.

vessel_id.description: For a vessel already separated, its id from the mod's notice; otherwise empty.

vessel.description: craft, or the name of the Child Vessel this sequence flies.

due_time_ut.description: The Due Time as UT in seconds, only when the wait before this sequence needs the player (e.g. docking or an EVA by hand); otherwise -1. A wait for a window, daylight or a hold goes inside the sequence's script, which warps there.

manual.description: True for a stretch the player flies by hand.

mission_time_s.description: Expected total Mission time in seconds, waits between sequences included; -1 if you can't say.

new_goal.description: Only when the player asked to change the Mission Goal itself: the new Mission Goal in their words, which replaces the old one if they approve this plan; otherwise empty.

vessel.description: craft, or the name of a Child Vessel from the Mission Plan: the script goes only to that vessel, over a CommNet path from you, and every other vessel of the Mission must be stable (in orbit, landed or splashed down) when it starts.

expected_duration_s.description: Seconds of game time from start to report, waits included; the mod stops a script still running at 300% of it.

telemetry_checks.description: What the mod watches while the sequence runs; crossing one sends you an Alert. Units: delta_v_used, delta_v_left and vertical_speed m/s; duration s since the start; apoapsis, periapsis and altitude m; inclination degrees; resource percent of capacity; fuel_margin percent of delta-v left over what the Mission Plan still needs. Config defaults fill any quantity you leave out.

resource.description: The resource name for quantity resource, e.g. ElectricCharge; otherwise empty.

direction.description: Crossed when the quantity goes above or below the threshold.

custom_script.description: True when the script is written from scratch instead of from Building Blocks.

custom_script_reason.description: For a Custom Script, one short sentence on why no Building Block fits; otherwise empty.

due_time_ut.description: The earliest UT in seconds the sequence may start, only when a wait that needs the player comes first; otherwise -1. The script itself warps through waits for windows, daylight or holds.

window_closes_ut.description: UT in seconds after which the planned window is missed, if the sequence depends on one; otherwise -1.

late_window_dv.description: Delta-v in m/s of the next window if the planned one is missed; -1 when there is none.

script.description: The complete Mission Script in kerboscript; empty for a manual stretch.

manual.description: True when the player flies this stretch by hand (docking, EVA science, or when they say they will fly it): the script is then empty.
